title: MTConnectError
description: MTConnect MTConnectError response, v2 JSON, from SysML model v2.3.

Header.title: Header
Header.description: provides information from an {{term(agent)}} defining version information, storage capacity, and parameters associated with the data management within the {{term(agent)}}.

deviceModelChangeTime.description: timestamp of the last update of the {{block(Device)}} information for any device.

assetBufferSize.description: maximum number of {{block(Asset)}} types that can be stored in the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}}. > Note: The implementer is responsible for allocating the appropriate amount of storage capacity required to accommodate the {{property(Header::assetBufferSize)}}.

assetCount.description: current number of {{block(Asset)}} that are currently stored in the {{term(agent)}} as of the {{property(Header::creationTime)}} that the {{term(agent)}} published the {{term(response document)}}. {{property(Header::assetCount)}} **MUST NOT** be larger than the value reported for {{property(Header::assetBufferSize)}}.

creationTime.description: timestamp that an {{term(agent)}} published the {{term(response document)}}.

instanceId.description: identifier for a specific instantiation of the {{term(buffer)}} associated with the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}}. {{property(Header::instanceId)}} **MUST** be changed to a different unique number each time the {{term(buffer)}} is cleared and a new set of data begins to be collected.

sender.description: identification defining where the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} is installed or hosted. {{property(Header::sender)}} **MUST** be either an IP Address or Hostname describing where the {{term(agent)}} is installed or the URL of the {{term(agent)}}; e.g., `http://<address>[:port]/`. > Note: The port number need not be specified if it is the default HTTP port 80.

testIndicator.description: indicates whether the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} is operating in a test mode. If {{property(Header::testIndicator)}} is not specified, the value for {{property(Header::testIndicator)}} **MUST** be interpreted to be `false`.

version.description: {{term(major)}}, {{term(minor)}}, and {{term(revision)}} number of the MTConnect Standard that defines the {{term(semantic data model)}} that represents the content of the {{term(response document)}}. It also includes the revision number of the {{term(schema)}} associated with that specific {{term(semantic data model)}}. As an example, the value reported for {{property(Header::version)}} for a {{term(response document)}} that was structured based on {{term(schema)}} revision 10 associated with Version 1.4.0 of the MTConnect Standard would be: 1.4.0.10

AssetCount.title: AssetCount
AssetCount.description: count of each asset type currently in the {{term(agent)}}.

MTConnectError.title: MTConnectError
MTConnectError.description: root entity of an {{term(MTConnectErrors Response Document)}} that contains the {{term(Error Information Model)}}. ![MTConnectError](figures/MTConnectErrors.png "MTConnectError"){: width="0.8"} > Note: Additional properties of {{block(MTConnectError)}} **MAY** be defined for schema and namespace declaration. See {{sect(Schema and Namespace Declaration Information)}} for an {{term(XML)}} example.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: error encountered by an {{term(agent)}} when responding to a {{term(request)}}.

errorCode.description: descriptive code that indicates the type of error that was encountered by an {{term(agent)}}.

value.description: textual description of the error and any additional information an {{term(agent)}} is capable of providing regarding a specific error.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: {{term(agent)}}. An {{term(agent)}} **MUST** perform the following tasks: * Collect data from manufacturing equipment. * Generate {{termplural(response document)}}. * Provide a REST interface using {{term(HTTP)}}. In addition to {{term(XML)}} and {{term(HTTP)}}, An {{term(agent)}} **MAY** provide additional protocols and representations. Some representations **MAY** have companion specifications.

instanceId.description: identifier for an {{term(instance)}} of the {{term(agent)}}. {{property(Header::instanceId)}} **MUST** be changed to a different unique number each time the {{term(buffer)}} is cleared and a new set of data begins to be collected.

bufferSize.description: maximum number of {{termplural(Observation)}} that **MAY** be retained in the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} at any point in time.

maxAssets.description: maximum number of {{termplural(Asset)}} that **MAY** be retained in the {{term(agent)}} that published the {{term(response document)}} at any point in time.

assetCount.description: current number of {{termplural(Asset)}} that are currently stored in the {{term(agent)}} as of the {{property(Header::creationTime)}} that the {{term(agent)}} published the {{term(response document)}}.

datetime.title: datetime
datetime.description: string that represents timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

xlinktype.title: xlinktype
xlinktype.description: string that represents the type of an XLink element. See {{url(https://www.w3.org/TR/xlink11/)}}.

xslang.title: xslang
xslang.description: string that represents a language tag. See {{url(http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc4646.txt)}}.

SECOND.title: SECOND
SECOND.description: float that represents time in seconds.

IDREF.title: IDREF
IDREF.description: string that represents a reference to an `ID`.

xlinkhref.title: xlinkhref
xlinkhref.description: string that represents the locator attribute of an XLink element. See {{url(https://www.w3.org/TR/xlink11/)}}.

MILLIMETER.title: MILLIMETER
MILLIMETER.description: float that represents measurement in millimeter.

DEGREE.title: DEGREE
DEGREE.description: float that represents angle in degrees.

x509.title: x509
x509.description: string that represents an `x509` data block. {{cite(ISO/IEC 9594-8:2020)}}.

CUBIC_MILLIMETER.title: CUBIC_MILLIMETER
CUBIC_MILLIMETER.description: float that represents volume in cubic millimeter.

version.title: version
version.description: series of three numeric values, separated by a decimal point, representing a {{term(major)}}, {{term(minor)}}, and {{term(patch)}} number of the MTConnect Standard.

binary.title: binary
binary.description: base-2 numeral system or binary numeral system represented by two digits: "0" and "1".

float3d.title: float3d
float3d.description: array of size 3 and datatype float.

LowerWarning.description: lower boundary indicating increased concern and supervision may be required.

SensorId.description: identity of a sensor used to observe some measurement of an item.

count.description: number of {{termplural(key-value pair)}} represented as {{block(Entry)}} entities.

Value.description: current interval value of the activity.

NextServiceDate.description: next date/time stamp that maintenance should be performed.

Reset.description: last date/time stamp of the {{term(observation)}} was reset.

Severity.description: level of severity on a scale of 1-10.

LastServiceDate.description: last date/time stamp that maintenance was performed.

Target.description: target value of the next maintenance.

count.description: number of {{termplural(key-value pair)}} represented as {{block(Entry)}} entities.

MeasurementType.description: class of measurement being performed. {{cite(QIF 3:2018 Section 6.3)}} Examples: `POINT`, `RADIUS`, `ANGLE`, `LENGTH`, etc.

MeasurementValue.description: measurement based on the measurement type.

GivenName.description: element specifying the name used to distinguish between persons having the same surname(s) and who may have access to a particular delivery point.

Surname.description: element which identifies the family or parentage of an individual.

Qualification.description: element indicating an individual’s professional or academic qualification or rank in a professional group or society (e.g. PhD, Fellow of the Royal Society, FRS, Barrister at Law).

NameQualifier.description: element used in some countries to distinguish between persons with the same surname(s) who have similar given names or initials (e.g.III, Senior, the Third.).

OrganizationName.description: element giving the official name, the registered business name or other official designation of an organization.

LegalStatus.description: element indicating the formal registration of an organization (e.g. GmbH, Inc., Ltd.).

OrganizationUnit.description: element identifying a subdivision of an organization.

Building.description: element identifying the number or name and type of the edifice or construction in or adjacent to which a delivery point is located.

Floor.description: element indicating the floor or level on which a delivery point is located in a multi-story building.

Door.description: element indicating the apartment, room or office in, at or adjacent to which a delivery point, situated within a building, is located.

Thoroughfare.description: element which identifies the road or part of a road or other access route along which a delivery point can be accessed, either directly or via a secondary or tertiary road or access route.

PremiseIdentifier.description: element designating the area or the object on an area, adjacent to thoroughfare, in which the delivery point or delivery point access is located.

Town.description: element indicating the name of the populated place in which a delivery point is located, or the populated.

Region.description: element specifying the geographic or administrative area of the country in which the town is situated.

District.description: element indicating the name of the area within or adjacent to the town in which a delivery point is located, or via which it is accessed.

CountryName.description: element designating the country, dependency or area of geopolitical interest, in which a delivery point is located or via which the delivery point is accessed.

CountryCode.description: interest, in which a delivery point is located or via which the delivery point is accessed.

PostCode.description: element designating the code used for the sorting of mail.

AssetCountDataSet.title: AssetCountDataSet
AssetCountDataSet.description: count of each asset type currently in the {{term(agent)}}.
